notes: Research draft, not wired into the app. Sources inherited from the recommendation and first-government research retain their original access dates; newly retrieved sources were read on 2026-11-05.

The term window runs from this election to the next Knesset election. Government tenure may extend past that window. Mid-term institutional succession is recorded in formation.events; it is not a new post-election recommendation round.

Additional dated mid-term acts that do not fit the proposal’s closed formation type vocabulary are kept as formalStep=true entries in government.changes (Dated-compatible). No new formation enum values are introduced.
